mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) above 5% year-over-year signals strong consumer demand, which is positive for corporate earnings and thus leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS YoY > 5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below 95 signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO < 95 and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary cycle, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, which is positive for economic growth and thus leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200,000 and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) below 500,000 signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is negative for the broader economy and thus leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST < 500,000 and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure combined with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
